GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Required. Embeds questions for retrieval (gemini-embedding-001), and answers them if no Anthropic key is set.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. With it, Claude answers (Haiku rewrites, Sonnet synthesizes); without it, Gemini does.

CHATQEC_INDEX_SNAPSHOT.description: Optional. URL of a full corpus snapshot. Without it, the Codespace indexes the canonical wiki only.
